text: Implemented the shared BIDS issue model and checked manifest construction. BidsIssue/BidsIssueReport give typed codes, severity, optional path/field context, deterministic ordering, and non-empty report invariants. BidsValidationReport supports collecting and strict enforcement. BidsManifest.fromRelativePaths remains compatible; fromRelativePathsChecked retains valid entries while distinguishing invalid BIDS candidates (errors), unsupported recognized roles (warnings), auxiliary files, and unrelated files (warnings). Verification: sbt 'bidsJVM/test' 'bidsJS/test' passed 56 JVM and 49 JS tests; git diff --check passed; no throw/return/null occurrences in the F1 paths.
